done_must_not_mean: production token or workspace deletion executed

uninstall.authority: verified app/uninstalled webhook or verified Shopify admin event
immediate_order: disable workspace access to new provider operations
invalidate or remove local Shopify session and offline token material
uninstall.reason: Uninstall is an access-stop event; Shopify shop/redact and the approved retention/deletion policy govern destructive workspace deletion.

ordered_actions: remove Shopify and provider credential material
delete or irreversibly anonymize shop-associated personal and workspace data according to the approved deletion manifest
shop_redact.legal_retention_exception: retain only data required by documented law or dispute obligations, isolated from product use and recorded with reason and expiry

customer_privacy_requests.customers_data_request: prepare a scoped export for the merchant using opaque subject identity
customer_privacy_requests.customers_redact: delete or irreversibly anonymize the scoped customer personal data and record redacted evidence

confirmation: require a second explicit server-verified confirmation
immediate_order: disable workspace product access and SnapshotJobs
remove credential material under provider-specific revoke safety rules
execute the versioned workspace deletion manifest asynchronously

within_shop_redact_delay.same_shop_identity: reuse the same workspace generation only if deletion has not begun
within_shop_redact_delay.shopify_note: Shopify does not emit shop/redact if the app is reinstalled before that webhook is delivered.

deletion_manifest_required_categories: Shopify session and offline token material
SnapshotJobs schedules leases and queued work
Dataset V2 and derived reporting artifacts
settings reporting account and currency data
billing and entitlement data subject to legal retention classification
audit and deletion evidence classified into delete anonymize or legally-retain
implementation_gates: Re-read current official Shopify privacy and webhook documentation.
Version and approve the exact table/object deletion manifest and dependency order.
Prove app configuration contains mandatory compliance topics.
Implement HMAC verification, invalid-HMAC 401, durable idempotent claims and 2xx acknowledgement.
Implement fail-closed scheduler and provider-operation shutdown before destructive work.
Add retry-safe asynchronous deletion and legal-retention isolation.
Test uninstall, reinstall before 48 hours, shop/redact, customer requests, Delete my data and clean reinstall.
Run repository CI, development-store webhook tests and separate production acceptance approvals.
acceptance: Uninstall immediately prevents new provider calls and SnapshotJobs but does not pretend that all data was deleted.
A verified shop/redact performs the approved manifest exactly once.
Invalid HMAC receives 401 and causes no claim or deletion.
Reinstall before shop/redact never creates a duplicate authoritative workspace.
Delete my data is available independently of uninstall and requires two explicit confirmations.
Clean reinstall cannot copy deleted Dataset, credentials or bindings into the new workspace generation.
Only minimum redacted evidence or documented legal-retention data survives terminal deletion.
The package remains implementation-pending until real webhook, persistence and acceptance gates pass.
